phase: Phase 2: Green — the updates and the lock file
summary: Security and supply-chain review of the harness lock-file refresh passes. npm audit --audit-level=high exits 0 with 0 critical and 0 high; the six Red high advisories resolve to their fixed versions; all 423 lock entries resolve to registry.npmjs.org with integrity hashes; no new direct dependency, no new lifecycle script package, and no git or tarball source; Playwright stays on system Chrome; the fixture is unchanged. The five residual moderates each carry a recorded reason (vitest and @vitest/mocker for score comparability, react-doctor 0.9.2 under spec D9).

evidence: Provenance: git rev-parse HEAD printed 84377792bfeac18196807336156cddc252aadaff before and after the audit; it equals role_base_sha and audited_head_sha. phase_base_sha b4c2e450067ca65b4282d0178ec087d00fa7a8e6 exists as a commit.
Audit gate: `cd harness && npm audit --audit-level=high` exited 0. `npm audit --json` metadata shows critical 0, high 0, moderate 5, low 0, info 0, total 5.

Six Red high advisories resolved to fixed versions in harness/package-lock.json: brace-expansion 5.0.13 (vulnerable 4.0.0-5.0.11), fast-uri 3.1.9 (3.0.0-3.1.8), nanoid 3.3.20 (below 3.3.18), source-map-js 1.2.4 (1.0.0-1.2.1), vite 8.3.8 (8.2.0-8.2.2), zod 4.6.7 (below 4.6.6).

Lock provenance: all 423 entries under packages have a resolved URL containing registry.npmjs.org (0 non-registry resolved) and every resolved entry carries an integrity hash (0 missing). No git or tarball source outside the registry.

Lifecycle scripts: package.json holds no preinstall, install, or postinstall script. hasInstallScript appears only on node_modules/esbuild, node_modules/fsevents, and node_modules/playwright/node_modules/fsevents. The fsevents entries are hoisting rearrangements of the base lock (base had top-level 2.3.2 plus nested under tsx and vite at 2.3.3; head has top-level 2.3.3 plus nested under playwright at 2.3.2); no genuinely new install-script package was added. No lock package carries a scripts field with a lifecycle hook.

New transitive package names versus base (bigmap, cacheable, hashery, hookified, memory, nonrecursive-glob-match, qified, serialize) come from flat-cache/keyv and carry no install script or bin; removed name json-buffer. No new direct dependency: package.json changed only @types/node 26.1.2 to 26.6.6 and tsx 4.23.1 to 4.23.15.

Residual moderates, each with a recorded reason: @vitest/mocker and vitest stay at 4.1.10 for score comparability within the cohort (Review A, orchestrator 2026-11-21); deslop-js, minimatch, and react-doctor stay at 0.9.2 under spec D9 because the 0.9.23 bump changes Axis 3 scores mid-cohort. No critical or high item remains.

Fixture scope: `git diff --name-only b4c2e45 84377792 -- fixture/` printed nothing. Playwright uses system Chrome: harness/playwright.config.ts:28 sets channel: "chrome", so no browser download runs. @playwright/test stays at the base 1.62.1 pin.

A2 not applicable: no test or tool in the audited range flips a draft to a published state; the publish gate (publish.ts, preview.sh) is untouched in the range. A6 clean: measure/tracks.md lists deps_refresh as pending and claims no resolved security state; the six high advisories are verified fixed rather than merely claimed.
Meta exclude list unchanged: harness/package.json test:meta:logic keeps the same two --exclude entries as the base commit.
